exampleSentence: It is imperative that the judicial committee review the constitutional amendment.

definition: To give an official order or commission to do something.
exampleSentence: International treaties mandate that carbon emissions be documented transparently.

definition: To demand or specify a requirement as part of an agreement.
exampleSentence: Academic bylaws stipulate that all doctoral dissertations be publicly defended.

definition: The act or an instance of insisting on something.
exampleSentence: At the auditor's firm insistence, all financial ledgers were subjected to forensic scrutiny.
The high court decreed that the public records be made accessible immediately.

definition: Demand or specify a requirement as part of a bargain.
exampleSentence: The armistice accords stipulate that all sovereign borders remain demilitarized.

definition: Give someone an official order or commission.
exampleSentence: Statutory bylaws mandate that each hospital trustee disclose potential conflicts.

definition: Order something by formal and authoritative command.
exampleSentence: The monarch decreed that political dissidents be granted unconditional amnesty.

definition: Put forward an idea or plan for consideration.
exampleSentence: Committee members proposed that the treasurer step down during the fiscal probe.

definition: Of critical necessity that something occur.
exampleSentence: It is vital that peace negotiators preserve confidentiality throughout bilateral summits.
